summary: 5-day course on AI in education for educators and instructional designers. Master AI tools, assessment redesign, learning analytics, and ethical governance. Enr
lede: AI in education focuses on using AI tools to support learning goals, assessment, and instructional decisions. For educators, instructional designers, and education leaders, this training develops practical skills to audit readiness, redesign assessments for AI-rich settings, and interpret learning analytics to identify learners who may need support. It also covers evaluating AI feedback for bias and drafting institutional AI use policies.
audienceIntro: This course is built for educators, instructional designers, and education leaders who are already working in teaching or learning design roles and want to move beyond surface-level AI experimentation toward structured, evidence-based integration. It suits professionals across K-12, higher education, vocational training, and corporate learning and development contexts.
audience: Education Policy Advisors and Quality Assurance Officers
modules: AI in Education: Landscape and Pedagogical Foundations
Pedagogical Frameworks for AI Tool Integration
AI-Enhanced Lesson Planning and Content Design
Reimagining Assessment in the Age of Generative AI
Ethics, Equity, and AI Governance in Education
AI Integration Roadmap and Stakeholder Communication
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop or tablet with internet access. A free or institutional account with at least one generative AI platform (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Google Gemini) should be set up before Day 1. Sample lesson plans, assessment tasks, or course materials from your current teaching context are required as working artefacts for workshop exercises. No specialist software licences are required — all tools used in the course are either free-tier accessible or provided as sample datasets and templates by the facilitator.
